answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and still isolated to the primary region, beginning after the release that shipped two hours ago, while settlement writes are at daily peak. Staged/canary gating (b6) can confine a bad build to the primary region, so the regional footprint does not rule out the release. Rollback (b1) previously restored checkout without dropping customer work; that is the only candidate that removes the suspected cause while keeping every region in service. Failover (b2) would dump peak settlement onto a smaller footprint, which b3 says we cannot spare. Circuit breaking would shed writes; read-replica routing does not sit on this write path. Residual chance this is regional infra rather than the build, so flag settlement-write risk and verify b1 for latency/write-safety caveats before committing the single window.
